Moiraine's task as Aes Sedai was the search for the Dragon Reborn and to guide him to the Last Battle. Egwene's role was very important to the world of Aes Sedai and it was not just to prepare them to fight but also important for the future of the White Tower. Egwene's time as Amyrlin was as crucial for the Last Battle as it was for the Fourth Age. Not even Cadsuane (who stands lower than Egwene in the One Power) could achieve in 270 years what Egwene did in one year. Cadsuane's idea of Moiraine would have had to change at some point as Moiraine came back from the dead to help saving the world. Cadsuane's return was not as important and it is impossible for her to disregard alliances Egwene formed.
